title: Creamy Chicken Pasta
summary: A quick creamy chicken pasta with simple spices, garlic, cream, and cheese. Good for a fast family meal.
steps: Heat oil and butter in a pan.
Add garlic paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add sliced chicken and cook until it changes color.
Season with salt, black pepper, and red chili flakes.
Add cream and milk, then simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add boiled pasta and mix until coated with sauce.
Add grated cheese and cook until melted.
